name: Staked USD Coin
oneLiner: HedgeCore sUSD is a soul-bound BSC yield wrapper minted from USDC and routed through Venus lending; early redemption is operator-controlled, not a backstop.
collateral: USDC deposited into HedgeCore and routed through Venus Protocol yield strategies on BSC
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDC to mint soul-bound sUSD, with yield distributed through HedgeCore mechanisms and liquidity exposed through hUSDC

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

notices.title: Restricted transfer and redemption path
notices.message: HedgeCore docs describe sUSD as soul-bound, and early redemption is operator-controlled rather than a general liquid backstop.

mintAuthority.summary: HedgeCore sUSD is a soul-bound BSC token whose minting is role-gated: only the authorized hUSDC wrapper contract (MINTER_ROLE/BURNER_ROLE) can mint or burn sUSD, with HedgeCore operating the deposit, Venus-yield, and operator-controlled redemption flow.

controls.label: HedgeCore sUSD token (MINTER_ROLE / BURNER_ROLE)
controls.capDescription: OpenZeppelin AccessControl MINTER_ROLE/BURNER_ROLE restricted to the authorized hUSDC wrapper contract; a 1 billion (18-decimal) max-supply cap is documented.
controls.evidence: Verified BscScan source and HedgeCore docs describe sUSD as a soul-bound token where only the authorized hUSDC wrapper contract holds MINTER_ROLE/BURNER_ROLE; minting occurs via hedgeWrap(), with admin functions (hedgeWrapLocked, hedgeSweep) and a 1B supply cap.

controls.label: HedgeCore operator (deposit / Venus strategy / redemption)
controls.evidence: HedgeCore docs describe an operator running the USDC deposit, Venus lending strategy, and operator-controlled early redemption; the soul-bound wrapper mint is gated behind this operator-controlled flow rather than a user-collateralized CDP.

review.evidence: HedgeCore documentation and the verified BscScan sUSD contract describe an operator-controlled, role-gated soul-bound wrapper (MINTER_ROLE/BURNER_ROLE on the wrapper contract) over a Venus yield strategy, not a user-collateralized CDP; on-chain role holders were not independently confirmed.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the exact address holding MINTER_ROLE/BURNER_ROLE on the sUSD token and the HedgeCore operator/admin multisig.
Confirm whether the documented 1B supply cap is governance-mutable.
